Chapter 2 — Geometry

Tessellate an open model with the manifold kernel, the same way as threejs.html.

Starting…

1. Configure settings

const settings = new geom.Settings();
settings.set('weld-vertices', false);
Waiting…

2. Create a geometry iterator

await runtime.loadPlugin('mapping', 'ifc4');
await runtime.loadPlugin('kernel', 'manifold');
const iterator = new geom.Iterator(settings, model, {
  geometryLibrary: 'manifold',
});
Waiting…

3. Iterate meshes

if (iterator.initialize()) do {
  const shape = iterator.get();
  const tri = shape.asTriangulationElement();
  const nativeGeometry = tri.geometry();
  let data;
  try {
    data = {
      vertices: nativeGeometry.vertsBuffer(Float32Array),
      faces: nativeGeometry.facesBuffer(Uint32Array),
    };
  } finally {
    nativeGeometry.destroy();
    tri.destroy();
    shape.destroy();
  }
  if (!data.faces.length) continue;
} while (iterator.next());
Waiting…

4. Inspect buffers

console.log(mesh.type, mesh.vertices.length / 3, mesh.faces.length / 3);
iterator.dispose();
model.dispose();
